This is the planned structure of the chapter, published so the curriculum can be reviewed before the prose is written. Each heading below becomes a section; the last section is what you will build and test. About 55 minutes when written.

11.1 · Where pairs come from

people, models, and your own sampled outputs.

What you build

A preference-pair builder from your own samples, with a bias audit. Every number it produces is asserted by a test, and the chapter's companion notebook recomputes it.
